notes: Cosmological/theoretical paper computing cold dark matter axion abundance from collapse of string-wall systems (misalignment + string decay + domain-wall decay). Main result (Eq. 96): upper bound on the axion decay constant F_a <= (2.0-3.8)x10^10 GeV, corresponding to a lower bound on the axion mass. Combined with astrophysical lower bound F_a >~ 1e9 GeV, allowed window is F_a ~ 1e9-1e10 GeV, m_a ~ 1e-3-1e-2 eV. This is an f_a-vs-m_a cosmological bound (AxionMass), not a coupling-constant exclusion curve. Emitted data points pair the two quoted F_a bound values (2.0e10 and 3.8e10 GeV) with masses computed from the paper's QCD axion mass relation (c0=1.46e-3, Lambda=400 MeV).
